description: Works out the CPR Part 47 detailed assessment timetable in England and Wales from the dates you have: the last day to serve the notice of commencement (N252), Points of Dispute, the first day for a default costs certificate (N254), Replies, the request for an assessment hearing (N258), provisional assessment steps and payment. Allows for deemed service, weekends, bank holidays and court office closures. Give at least the right to costs (its kind and date).

certificateDate.description: The date of the final or interim costs certificate, if issued (YYYY-MM-DD).

hearingDate.description: The date of the detailed assessment hearing, if one is listed (YYYY-MM-DD).

hearingEnded.description: The date the detailed assessment hearing ended, if it has (YYYY-MM-DD).

noticeServed.description: The date the notice of commencement was served (deemed service), if it has been (YYYY-MM-DD).

pointsServed.description: The date Points of Dispute were served, if they have been (YYYY-MM-DD).

provisionalReceived.description: The date the provisional assessment was received, if there was one (YYYY-MM-DD).

rightToCostsDate.description: The date of that judgment, order or event (YYYY-MM-DD).

rightToCostsKind.description: What gave the right to costs: "judgment" (Judgment or order), "stay-lifted" (Stay lifted after appeal), "discontinuance-served" (Discontinuance served), "discontinuance-upheld" (Discontinuance upheld), "part-36-accepted" (Part 36 offer accepted).

name: calculate_detailed_assessment_deadlines
title: Detailed assessment deadline calculator (CPR Part 47)
